name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceMultipleRewardInflationEnterActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a multi-step ad offers an entry screen to register or try the promoted app. It shows the reward amount and starts that app-experience step.
disableEffect: This reward-entry step will no longer open, and its associated ad rewards will not be granted.
